verdict.rationale: Vendor docs explicitly claim Ubuntu as a primary platform for IDEs, AI/ML tooling, and cutting-edge dev workflows (including WSL AI/ML tooling), and community threads confirm long-term developer use, but there's no independent evidence of specific latest-IDE/toolchain compatibility, package freshness, or hands-on AI/ML dev workflow validation; some community feedback focuses on driver/hardware quirks rather than dev tooling currency. Missing for 10: independent verification of latest IDE/toolchain availability and version currency, hands-on AI/ML dev experience reports, and confirmation of continuous up-to-date package/toolchain support.
